thread:
maya: Quick: finance + ops want a single ask for HW partners covering reserved vs spot economics + eviction proof. Can someone draft? Need to send by EOD.

tom: Minimal must-haves: sku_id, region, reserved_price_hr, reserved_term_months, reserved_guarantee_pct, can_release_early(boolean), early_release_penalty_usd, spot_price_percentiles (p10/p50/p90), spot_time_series_link (csv iso8601,price_usd), eviction_rate_pct_per_day, eviction_notice_seconds, eviction_credit_type(hourly_credit/monthly_rebate), eviction_credit_amount, min_running_seconds_for_credit.

priyanka: Add billing granularity (30s/60s/3600s), whether they round up, marketplace_listing_fee_pct, per_invoice_fee_usd, and channel_partner_margin_pct. Also timezone for availability windows.

jacob: Ops: include whether reserved capacity is "pinned" (dedicated pool) or "shared" and if pinned, how much of the SKU is reserved for SI/private racks. Also ask for penalty curve link if early release has nonlinear steps.

legal-bot: Note: if asking for proof of eviction, request sample event schema with fields: timestamp, instance_id, eviction_id, notice_seconds, reason, terminated_at, credit_applied(Boolean), credit_amount_usd. Indicate redaction allowed for customer identifiers.

priyanka: Example single-row CSV we can paste into outreach:``` 
sku-001,OrbitCloud,us-west-1,p4d.24xlarge,A100-80GB,96,1536,12.50,12,99,true,15000,2.80,0.9,2.5,5.0,https://s3.redwood/partners/orbit/spot_14d.csv,0.35,300,hourly_credit,25,300,60,true,0.03,1.00,5.0,UTC,24x7,pinned:50units
```

maya: Nice. Also ask partners to provide volume discount table either as inline columns (tier1_units,tier1_disc_pct...) or a linked csv if complex.

tom: Request percentiles preferred over mean/std, and if only mean/std provided state sample size & collection window. We'll convert to percentiles but need the info.

jacob: For eviction_notice_seconds clarify whether it's typical or guaranteed minimum. Ask them to flag which.

priyanka: I'll draft the outreach note with bullet list + the CSV template + a short legal paragraph on credits and proofs. Posting draft here in 30m.

partner-bot: Upload: outreach/templates/hw_pricing_single_payload_v2.csv :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks — we'll gate marketplace listing updates on receiving at least 7 days of spot history + stated credit rules. Follow-up sync Fri 9am to review partials. :thumbsup:
